_comment: Coverage ratchet floor. MO-89 (2026-09-16) replaced the never-regenerated bootstrap value (65.23, taken from a pyproject comment) with a floor derived from a REAL measurement: the full suite (14976 passing tests, Windows, `pytest tests/ -n auto --dist=loadgroup --cov=voice_typer`) measured 84.84% total line coverage (37491/44193 statements, 459 files) with ZERO 0%-coverage modules. The floor is set 4.84 points BELOW that measurement on purpose: the ratchet runs only on the canonical ubuntu x 3.12 leg (.github/workflows/build.yml) while coverage is measured on every OS, and platform-conditional code (windows/ ~4.8% of statements, linux/ ~1.6%, macos/ ~1.1%) cannot be exercised identically everywhere. A 80.0 floor still removes the ~19 points of slack the bootstrap value left, so any real erosion now fails CI. Raise it ONLY on a fresh measurement (scripts/coverage_ratchet_check.py --regenerate); never lower it to accommodate a drop.
_source: MO-89: full-suite measurement 84.84% (Windows, 14976 passed / 0 failed), floor set with cross-platform headroom

_previous.source: bootstrapped 2026-07-24 from the pyproject.toml aspirational target (65.23%), never regenerated from a real run
